content.title: Relationship Realignment | Ensemble, Dyad, New Position
content.summary: Establish three public roles on one shared axis, isolate a pair without losing the larger-group context, and update their relationship through speaking turns, eye lines, and micro-actions. One motivated axis crossing converts the exchange into a new lead-follow or front-back position.

quick_start.input_format: Open group three roles + double isolation + gradually tightened visible communication and micro-movements + single cross-axis + new final state of the relationship
quick_start.recommended_input: In the original felt tide clock workshop, the red scarf apprentice, the brass mask evaluator and the blue apron clockkeeper stand on the same inspection line, with the large repaired clock door behind fixing the spatial axis; the apprentice checks the dial gap and looks towards the evaluator, the evaluator puts down the measuring arm and only makes a slight nod, the identities of the characters, scarves and tools are stable; the apprentice walks in front with the closed dial, and the evaluator follows one step behind. The distant clockkeeper remains at the calibration table, and the clock blades only start to rotate slowly and synchronously once
required_anchors: Establish at least three readable public roles in one shared spatial axis before isolating a pair.
Isolate one dyad while keeping enough background context to remember the larger group.
Use one motivated crossing of the established axis to convert the exchange into a visible position change.
End with both members readable in a new lead-follow or front-back relationship.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Establish three public roles on one shared axis, isolate a pair without losing the larger-group context, and update their relationship through speaking turns, eye lines, and micro-actions. One motivated axis crossing converts the exchange into a new lead-follow or front-back position.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish a public ensemble and the initial spatial roles of at least three figures, then isolate one dyad while the larger group remains contextual evidence. Progressively tighten coverage through visible speaking turns, gaze and small physical responses without assigning unsupported dialogue meaning. Resolve the exchange through one motivated axis crossing, then reopen the frame on a new lead-follow or front-back relationship. The reusable mechanism is spatial relationship realignment, not a specific costume drama or conversation premise.

invariants.rule: Establish at least three readable public roles in one shared spatial axis before isolating a pair.
invariants.purpose: Provides a relationship baseline that can later change.
invariants.ablation_failure: Beginning directly on two faces removes proof that the pair was extracted from a larger public arrangement.

invariants.rule: Isolate one dyad while keeping enough background context to remember the larger group.
invariants.purpose: Transfers attention without erasing the social frame.
invariants.ablation_failure: A context-free close-up makes the exchange private and loses the public-position mechanism.

invariants.rule: Tighten from paired body-scale coverage to smaller gaze, mouth or head changes without inventing dialogue meaning.
invariants.purpose: Makes the relationship update inspectable through visible performance.
invariants.ablation_failure: Constant shot scale or inferred semantics turns the middle into unsupported explanation.

invariants.rule: Use one motivated crossing of the established axis to convert the exchange into a visible position change.
invariants.purpose: Turns interpersonal change into spatial evidence.
invariants.ablation_failure: A cut to an unrelated pose cannot prove how the relation was reorganized.

invariants.rule: End with both members readable in a new lead-follow or front-back relationship.
invariants.purpose: Closes the sequence on an inspectable new arrangement.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending on an isolated face leaves the spatial result unresolved.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source cloud-top Chinese fantasy platform, monumental gate and distant floating architecture
the source white-robed and green-robed women, older white-haired man, swords and public formation
the source exact two-woman speaking and eye-contact order
the source cheek mark, hair ornaments, robe palette and sword staging
the source exact foreground walk-past and white-robed follower ending

instantiations.concept: In original felt stop-motion at a tidal-clock workshop, three harbor artisans begin in one inspection line. A red-scarf apprentice and a brass-mask assessor separate beside a calibration table, exchange two silent inspection gestures as the view tightens, then the apprentice crosses the marked floor line and the assessor follows behind into the repaired clock passage.

instantiations.concept: In a clean robotics lab, three palm-sized service robots start at aligned charging bays. Two roll into a shared test lane, trade short light and arm responses under progressively closer views, then the smaller unit crosses the lane marker and the taller unit follows into a new front-back docking order.
